test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘DESIGN’ is coded as 8-10-38-18-14-28 and ‘FOREST’ is coded as 12-30-36-10-38-40. How will ‘PLAYER’ be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

‘DESIGN’ is coded as 8-10-38-18-14-28.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f85c49fd8a960ef28228caf88d95d5bf4939dcd612af33cbce5bb59600cb9ae5.png] 

and

‘FOREST’ is coded as 12-30-36-10-38-40.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/329785f5c41a3e0103d03290e508c05043e71e0ae08fb3d3d2b1d178ac66ffe4.png] 

Similarly,

‘PLAYER’ will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af6c64c3a6644db938ae036e9ba066166cd33752b8073ee793efb1e168cdd245.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"32-24-2-50-10-36".**
